novel_features.name: Fleet execution health
novel_features.description: One-call workflow execution health for an org: succeeded / failed / running / pending counts plus time saved, with a clear unhealthy verdict when failures are present.

novel_features.name: Failure triage
novel_features.description: Recent failed workflow executions for an org, newest first, with workflow id, status, task counts, and age — the triage queue the API has no single endpoint for.

novel_features.name: Automation ROI rollup
novel_features.description: Aggregates Rewst's humanSecondsSaved metric across an org's workflows into total hours/days saved and the top time-saving automations.

novel_features.name: Dormant automation detector
novel_features.description: Workflows that have not executed in N days — dead or orphaned automation that is still installed but no longer running.

novel_features.name: Cross-org config drift
novel_features.description: Compares org variables and installed packs between two organizations and reports what one has that the other is missing.

novel_features.name: Pack coverage matrix
novel_features.description: Across a parent org's managed sub-orgs, shows which integration packs are installed where and flags orgs missing a pack — bounded by a scan cap.
